final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) as avg_remaincount FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaincount) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.ordersmark, s1.avg_remaincount, s1.avg_remaincount - s2.overall_avg as diff FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s1.avg_remaincount > s2.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaincount) as avg_of_col2 FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.ordersmark, s3.avg_remaincount, s3.diff, s3.avg_remaincount - s4.avg_of_col2 as diff2 FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s3.avg_remaincount > s4.avg_of_col2) SELECT AVG(avg_remaincount) as avg_col2, AVG(diff) as avg_col3, AVG(diff2) as avg_col4 FROM step5
